notes.title: Your House: Where Secrets Begin
notes.content:
[h2][h3]Hey, unmemory fans! Here's some exciting news that's sure to brighten your day: the Your House demo is out, and it’s the perfect prequel to everything we love about unmemory.[/h3][/h2]

[h3]Your House: The Origin Story[/h3]
Ever wondered where Debbie—our future leader of the Killer Kittens—truly comes from? Your House takes you straight to the heart of her beginnings. It all kicks off on her 18th birthday, when she receives a mysterious package: a letter, a key, and a destiny that leads her to a sprawling mansion brimming with secrets. It might seem like a familiar trope, yet every corner unveils a mystery that challenges expectations and sparks genuine curiosity.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309260/YOUR_HOUSE_Demo/

[h3]How It Connects to unmemory[/h3]
The coolest part is that this story isn’t floating in a vacuum. As Debbie roams through the mansion, piecing together clues about an elegant thief, a daring architect, and a mysterious wife, she gradually realizes that all these personas are intertwined in the most unexpected ways. This journey of revelations lays the perfect groundwork for her transformation into the unstoppable leader of the Killer Kittens.

[h3]A Visual and Interactive Adventure[/h3]
Your House is like an interactive novel that dares you to solve puzzles as you dive into a thriller with a retro ‘90s vibe. And here’s a treat for the eyes: instead of the evocative photographs that defined unmemory, this time we’ve embraced comic noir illustrations. These edgy visuals not only capture the nostalgic essence of the '90s but also add a distinctive, gritty charm that perfectly complements the mystery and irony woven throughout the story.

[previewyoutube=e2qyE95jmUs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Why You Should Try the Demo[/h3]
If you love cracking puzzles and uncovering secrets with a generous dose of irony, then the Your House demo is your next must-experience adventure. Here’s what you can expect:
[list]
[*] A story that cleverly bridges unmemory’s past and future, prompting you to rethink everything you thought you knew.
[*] Intricate puzzles that will test your skills and sometimes make you scratch your head as you piece together the mystery of Debbie’s origins.
[*] A uniquely nostalgic and mysterious atmosphere, enhanced by striking comic noir illustrations that elevate the overall experience.
[/list]
So, if you thought unmemory was the pinnacle, think again. Your House invites you to unlock its secrets, embrace the unexpected, and dive into an interactive experience that you won’t want to miss.

Come on—step into Your House and discover how it all began!
